title: Chapter 1415 - 2: Time-Space Shop

Chapter 1415 - 2: Time-Space Shop

Chapter 1415: Chapter 2: Time-Space Shop

After Lin Yuan condensed his past self, he only slightly tried exploring past timelines.

But he merely skimmed the surface without delving deeply, and only considered the present self as an anchor point, making it easy to lose oneself.

Many Time Lords disappeared without a trace, mostly getting lost in the past timelines.

Otherwise, considering the other two paths of transcendence, ’Infinite Calamity’—even if one fails at tribulation, before the consciousness of the Supreme Rule Dao descends to wipe out, there’s still some ability to arrange for aftermaths.

And the Perfect Life? The movement upon entering the Fourteenth Rank is enormous, with that transformation phenomenon from a time life to a Perfect Time Being, even if the final result fails, it leaves a profound impact, even ruins.

Only the Infinite Origin Source seems much safer than the other two paths, but its true dangers aren’t much lower.

But now? The future self is formed, the past, future, and present seem like one.

Even if Lin Yuan isn’t a Lord, he is better able to resist the peril of getting lost than ordinary Lords.

And the peril of getting lost can only be encountered at extremely ancient past time nodes.

Lin Yuan merely explored a bit, nothing would go wrong.

The timeline continuously flows backward, and Lin Yuan becomes more cautious.

"Except for me, everything is illusion?"

Lin Yuan glanced around, at this moment, he was situated in a past timeframe two Great Extinction Cycles away from the present.

"Must not leave any trace."

Lin Yuan thought to himself, leaving traces or influences in the past timeline could be big or small.

If small, it wouldn’t bring changes to the future, and there’d be no trouble.

But if it’s significant, like affecting the occurrence of a major event, the backlash force originating from the timeline would be a headache even for Lords.

"Blue Cliff Mountain."

Soon, Lin Yuan arrived at a past timeline twelve Great Extinction Cycles away from the present, gazing at a blue icy mountain that doesn’t fit in with the surrounding phantom objects.

In the eyes of non-time beings from this timeline, this blue icy mountain is very apparent, every Lord who explores this timeframe can discover it.

For those at the Third Realm level Lord, the means to influence the past, establishing a place in the past timeline for ’interaction’ that only Lords can find and enter isn’t hard.

"Go in."

Lin Yuan’s mind slightly moved.

He directly stepped in.

Establishing an ’interaction’ place within the past timeline, besides being sufficiently covert, is also for safety reasons.

After all, this type of ’interaction’ place, those who entered are from non-present timelines, they wouldn’t act rashly.

For two beings at Lord level, unless they’re crazy, they definitely wouldn’t dare to fight in the past timeline, as the shockwaves from their combat would affect and eventually accumulate into overwhelming backlash...

Inside Blue Cliff Mountain lies a vast world, a terrifying presence gathering in threes and twos, all of them Time Lords.

Basically, every Time Lord leaves a spiritual avatar in Blue Cliff Mountain, facilitating exchange with other Time Lords at any time.

After Lin Yuan entered, he didn’t draw attention from other Time Lords.

In the outside world, Time Lords are extremely rare, hard to find in vast dimensional gap areas.

But here... those who can enter are all Time Lords, time beings below Lord level can’t even discover it.

Of course, Lin Yuan is an exception, though not a Time Lord, he’s indistinguishable from them.

"Spacetime Shop?"

Lin Yuan approached a structure with ’Spacetime Shop’ carved into its surface.

Since Blue Cliff Mountain is a place for Lord level ’exchange,’ naturally there’s a place for transactions too.

Lin Yuan stepped inside, quickly greeted by a creature with twelve eyes.

"May I ask what you seek?"

The twelve-eyed creature spoke gently.

"Such a strong oppressive feeling?" Lin Yuan was startled; this twelve-eyed beast’s spiritual avatar alone gave him an oppression stronger than the Three-Life Immortal Emperor.

"I want some Third Realm materials." Lin Yuan hadn’t forgotten his purpose.

To evolve the Origin Clock into a Lord-grade weapon, it requires a large amount of Third Realm materials.

"Please take a look."

The twelve-eyed beast didn’t say much, flipping its hand to form layers of light screens.

Recorded on them were numerous Lord-grade materials.

Prices ranged from low to high, with the lowest being ten thousand Time Sand, and the highest reaching billions of Time Sand, some couldn’t be exchanged with Time Sand and require barter.

"Too expensive." Lin Yuan realized he was very poor.

Although possessing Lord-grade battle power, ultimately his accumulation time was too short, poorer compared to normal Second Realm time beings.

A typical Lord, having gone through long years of cultivation and gradual accumulation, is never as poor as Lin Yuan.

"I’ll consider a bit more."

Lin Yuan said.

"No problem."

The twelve-eyed beast had no objections.

Lord-grade materials are valuable, naturally comparing among different shops is necessary.

"I see you’re here at Blue Cliff Mountain for the first time, surely you just stepped into the Third Realm, right?"

The twelve-eyed creature looked at Lin Yuan, smiling while inquiring.

"Yes."

Lin Yuan nodded.

Most seasoned Lords leave a long-term spiritual avatar within Blue Cliff Mountain.

Lin Yuan hadn’t appeared here before, evidently his first time, which usually happens to newly ascended Lords.

"We time beings undergo countless tribulations, finally reaching the Third Realm, only to discover how arduous the path of transcendence is." The twelve-eyed creature couldn’t help but express some emotions.

In the eyes of First Realm and Second Realm time beings, Time Lords are lofty, traversing past timelines with incredibly inconceivable methods.
